data.description:
**Apply Here**
https://recruiting.ultipro.com/CON1019ACADE/JobBoard/c2b42121-092c-4125-8209-60593d2c63e0/Opportunity/OpportunityDetail?opportunityId=33d05808-532d-43fe-a54d-60ee775b2a44
  
  
**School Summary**
At Connections Academy, helping students maximize their potential and meet the highest performance standards through a uniquely individualized learning program is at the core of our mission. Connections Academy was founded in 2001 to deliver high-quality, highly accountable online education to students in grades K-12. Hallmarks of Connections Academy-supported online schools include personalized learning, an award-winning curriculum and Education Management System (EMS), dedicated state-certified teachers, and a supportive school community. Parents of enrolled students consistently share their satisfaction with Connections Academy: 92% “would recommend the schools to other families” and 95% say the curriculum is “high quality.” Connections Academy-supported public schools serve students across the country, while Connections Academy is committed to expanding quality education through technology and helping students achieve both academic and personal success.
  
  
Maine Connections Academy (MCA) is a tuition-free, virtual public charter school for students in grades 7–12 statewide. MCA is authorized by the Maine Charter School Commission and is governed by an independent Board of Directors.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The
**LiveLesson Attendance Coordinator**
is a
**1-year, full-time, 10-month position, grant-funded,**
focused on increasing student attendance and engagement in LiveLesson instructional sessions. The coordinator will work with students, families, teachers, counselors, and school leaders to identify students who are not consistently attending LiveLessons, determine and address barriers to participation, and provide targeted interventions and ongoing support to improve attendance.
  
  
**As a Term of Project position, employment will continue through the duration of the specific term which ends June 21, 2027.**
Particular attention will be given to students who have the greatest academic need for synchronous instructional support, including students who are failing or at risk of failing courses, students demonstrating patterns of disengagement, and students identified by teachers or school teams as needing additional intervention.
  
  
The LiveLesson Attendance Coordinator will use attendance and academic data to identify trends and prioritize outreach; meet directly with students and families to understand barriers; develop individualized attendance plans and interventions; monitor student progress; and provide persistent follow-up and encouragement. The coordinator will also partner with teachers to support attendance efforts for individual students, specific courses, grade levels, and LiveLessons experiencing attendance concerns.
  
  
This position serves as a key connection between students, families, teachers, and school leadership and will help ensure that students who most need direct instructional support are consistently connected to their teachers and learning opportunities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

- Monitor LiveLesson attendance and academic data to identify students with low or declining attendance, prioritizing students who are failing, at risk of failing, or otherwise in need of additional instructional support.
- Conduct proactive outreach and meet with students and families to identify barriers to LiveLesson attendance and develop individualized strategies to address them.
- Provide targeted attendance interventions, including reminders, goal setting, problem-solving, accountability, and ongoing follow-up.
- Build positive relationships with students and families while maintaining clear expectations for attendance, engagement, and academic progress.
- Track student contacts, barriers, interventions, attendance patterns, and outcomes; adjust supports when students are not demonstrating improvement.
- Support attendance improvement efforts for specific courses, sections, grade levels, or student groups experiencing attendance concerns.
- Collaborate with teachers, counselors, special education staff, interventionists, administrators, Bright Futures teacher, and other school staff to coordinate appropriate student supports and interventions.
- Participate in MTSS/RTI, grade-level, student support, attendance, and family meetings as appropriate.
- When regular LiveLesson attendance is not reasonably possible due to an ongoing barrier, work with the student, family, and teacher to establish an alternative engagement plan. This may include watching LiveLesson recordings, accessing instructional materials, completing related assignments or assessments, and maintaining communication with teachers.
- Monitor students using alternative engagement plans to ensure they are consistently accessing instruction, completing required work, and making academic progress.
- Analyze LiveLesson attendance trends and maintain reports, student lists, or other tools that provide teachers and school leaders with actionable attendance information.
- Support schoolwide strategies and communications designed to increase LiveLesson attendance and help students and families understand the connection between participation, engagement, and academic success.
- Maintain accurate records, confidentiality, and compliance with applicable school policies and procedures.
- Other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

- Bachelor’s degree preferred, particularly in education, counseling, social work, psychology, youth development, or a related field.
- Experience working with middle and/or high school students, particularly students experiencing academic, attendance, engagement, or motivational challenges.
- Experience working with at-risk youth or providing student interventions is strongly preferred.
- Strong commitment to helping students overcome barriers and remain engaged in their education.
- Student-focused, relationship-centered approach.
- Demonstrated ability to build rapport with students and families while maintaining clear expectations and accountability.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Comfortable initiating frequent outreach to students and families, including situations where previous outreach attempts have been unsuccessful.
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify individualized solutions to barriers affecting student participation.
- Strong organizational, project management, and follow-through skills.
- High level of attention to detail.
- Ability to manage and monitor a caseload of students requiring varying levels of intervention.
- Ability to analyze attendance and academic data and use that information to prioritize student support.
- Strong technology skills and ability to learn school data, communication, and instructional systems.
- Self-motivated and able to work independently in a virtual environment.
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with teachers, counselors, administrators, and other school staff.
- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and adjust priorities based on student needs.
- High degree of flexibility.
- Ability to work remotely as necessary.
- Willingness to occasionally work evening hours to accommodate student and family schedules.
- Ability to travel within Maine on an occasional basis if needed to support students, families, or school activities.

Salary Range: $42,500-$60,500

From screening to research and development, Lunit is transforming how the world advances cancer detection — boldly, intelligently, and with humanity at the core.

We build trusted partnerships with clinicians, health systems, and companies worldwide to deliver validated AI solutions that enhance clinical confidence, accelerate discovery, prioritize precision care — and bring the future of cancer diagnostics within reach.

To find out how you could contribute to our mission to conquer cancer as a Customer Education & Engagement Team Manager please read on.

**Purpose:**

The Customer Education & Engagement Team Manager will own the development and execution of scalable education and engagement programs that enable customers to confidently adopt, optimize, and expand their use of Lunit breast software across USCAN, LATAM, and EU. This role translates customer needs, product capabilities, and clinical workflow requirements into high-impact learning experiences for radiologists, technologists, and clinical and operational teams. Working closely with Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Onboarding/Implementation, the Customer Education & Engagement Lead will build programs that support successful onboarding, on-time go-lives, sustained utilization, and long-term customer advocacy.

**What you'll be doing:**

- Lead the regional execution of customer education and engagement programs that drive adoption, proficiency, workflow optimization, and long-term utilization of Lunit breast software.
- Design and maintain scalable learning pathways for customer onboarding, go-live readiness, release-based training, advanced workflow optimization, and ongoing product enablement.
- Partner with Customer Onboarding/Implementation to embed training milestones, completion tracking, and readiness criteria into customer project plans to support successful deployments and revenue recognition timelines.
- Develop a comprehensive education calendar that includes live training, virtual sessions, on-demand modules, webinars, masterclasses, user group discussions, and customer community events.
- Create and maintain high-quality training materials, including e-learning modules, workflow simulations, video tutorials, quick-reference guides, facilitator materials, and customer-facing educational resources.
- Ensure education content remains aligned with product updates, the Lunit roadmap, regulatory requirements, and evolving breast imaging workflows and clinical guidelines.
- Partner with Marketing to launch customer education and thought-leadership programs that strengthen Lunit’s market presence, showcase customer expertise, and reinforce Lunit as a premium and innovative partner.
- Manage and optimize the Absorb LMS customer training experience, including enrollment paths, certification tracking, reporting, learner engagement, and consumption analytics.
- Leverage Higher Logic Vanilla to support digital community engagement, peer-to-peer learning, customer feedback loops, exclusive educational events, and champion cultivation.
- Build strong relationships with customer champions, clinical stakeholders, subject matter experts, and internal teams to ensure education programs reflect real-world customer needs and measurable business outcomes.
- Define, monitor, and report on education and engagement KPIs, including training completion, learner satisfaction, time-to-value, adoption indicators, community engagement, certification progress, and training impact.
- Collaborate with Clinical Affairs and Marketing to explore accredited CME or CE opportunities where appropriate and aligned with business objectives.
- Identify opportunities to use education as a customer success and commercial enablement tool, helping reduce churn risk, increase utilization, support renewals, and uncover expansion opportunities.

**What you will bring to the role:**

- Bachelor’s degree required in Clinical/Healthcare Sciences, Healthcare Administration, Instructional Design, Education, Business, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
- 5+ years of experience in customer education, clinical training, customer success enablement, professional education, instructional design, or customer engagement within MedTech, Healthcare IT, Medical Imaging, or SaaS environments.
- Experience supporting enterprise healthcare customers, imaging centers, radiology teams, or clinical software implementations strongly preferred.
- Demonstrated ability to build scalable training programs, learning pathways, and customer-facing education assets from concept through execution.
- Strong understanding of medical imaging workflows, including PACS, RIS, radiology operations, and mammography or breast imaging environments; familiarity with AI clinical decision support tools is a plus.
- Working knowledge of adult learning principles, instructional design practices, and modern learning delivery models, including live, virtual, on-demand, and blended learning.
- Hands-on experience with LMS administration, preferably Absorb LMS, including course configuration, learner enrollment, reporting, certification management, and analytics.
- Experience with digital community platforms, preferably Higher Logic Vanilla, and an understanding of how community engagement supports customer adoption and education.
- Proficiency with content authoring and training development tools such as Articulate Storyline/Rise, video tools, presentation platforms, and CRM or customer data systems such as Salesforce.
- Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple education initiatives, customer deadlines, and cross-functional deliverables across regions.
- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with radiologists, technologists, executives, clinical stakeholders, and internal teams.
- High degree of customer empathy, operational discipline, and attention to detail, with a commitment to delivering polished, practical, and measurable learning experiences.
- Ability to influence without authority and collaborate effectively across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Clinical Affairs, and Implementation teams.
- Fluency in English required; proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, or key European languages is highly advantageous.
- Willingness to travel up to 30–40% across USCAN, LATAM, and EU for customer go-lives, site visits, trainings, and industry events.

**What you will receive:**

The salary range for this role is $150,000 - $175,000 per annum, full time equivalent. Benefits include the option to participate in medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurances; a 401K plan with a company match; and generous paid time off.

**Other things to note:**

- This role will be hybrid if the successful applicant lives within commuting distance of our US office (Lynnwood, WA). For candidates outside this location, the role will be fully remote.
- Candidates must currently have the right to work in the United States to apply.
- Lunit International operates across multiple time zones, and this role may occasionally require working outside of standard business hours to support international customers or team collaboration. We offer flexible scheduling to help balance these needs with personal commitments/work life balance.
- Proof of COVID 19 vaccination required, except in limited circumstances where a legally recognized medical or religious exemption may be able to be accommodated.

*Lunit International is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We will endeavor to fill vacancies with the candidate who is the best fit for the role, without regard to gender, marital or family status, religious or ethical belief, race, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, political opinion, employment status, military status, sexual orientation or any other status protected by law.*

**Position**
Customer Success Content & Enablement Manager
  
  
**Job Description**
**Help Us Shape the Future of Supply Chain Intelligence**
The global electronics supply chain isn’t getting simpler — but at SiliconExpert, we’re helping the world navigate it with confidence.
  
  
We’ve evolved from delivering data to delivering
**Trusted Intelligence**
—connecting billions of data points to help teams anticipate risk, adapt faster, and design smarter.
  
  
To meet the moment, we're expanding our Customer Experience organization.
  
  
We're looking for customer-focused professionals who are passionate about helping users succeed, thrive at the intersection of content, enablement, and customer advocacy, and believe in the power of turning customer insights into measurable outcomes.
  
  
If you're excited about shortening customers' time-to-value, empowering Customer Success teams, and showcasing the real impact our solutions deliver, we'd love to meet you.
  
  
**Customer Success Content & Enablement Manager**
sits at the intersection of technical writing, internal training, and customer marketing. You will own the end-to-end content ecosystem that drives user adoption, empowers our internal Customer Success (CS) and Sales team, and showcases customer ROI. Your goal is to shorten the customer's "time-to-value" while building a library of powerful customer success stories.
  
  
This role will project manage the content ecosystem and prepare documents related to that ecosystem. They will also be responsible for sales training (enablement) on how to prove ROI and set customers up for success.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

- Leading complex cross functional.
- Leads project calls, assigns work and manages project to timeline and outcomes.
- Stakeholder management—Leads stakeholder management sessions and keeps various management abreast of potential issues by maintaining open lines of communication.
- Creation of project related process documents.
- Assist in training new and existing employees with regard to policies and procedures related to project outcomes.
- Green Belt Certified.
- PMP Certified.

**What We Are Looking For**

- Requires experience in the following tools: HubSpot, Zendesk, Pendo (preferred), and Salesforce.
- Marketing background related to content creation and building email campaigns, with awareness of GDPR regulations
- Requires 3-5 years of experience in content creation and project management.
- Requires in-depth knowledge on the electronics supply chain industry and experience with SaaS.
- Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective using existing solutions
- Works independently; receives minimal guidance
- Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience
- Represents the level at which career may stabilize for many years or even until retirement
- Contributes to process improvements
- Typically resolves problems using existing solutions

- Works with minimal guidance

**Work Arrangement**

- Hybrid if in Colorado: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday required office days for Panorama Office site; Monday, Friday-work from home.
- Fully remote for other locations listed: Must be able to travel to an Arrow office location as requested by Arrow leadership.

**Education/Experience**

- Typically requires 5–7 years of related experience with a 4 year degree; or 3 years and an advanced degree; or equivalent work experience.

**What’s In It For You**
At Arrow, we recognize that financial rewards and great benefits are important aspects of an ideal job. That’s why we offer competitive financial compensation, including various compensation plans and a solid benefits package.
  
  

- Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
- 401k, With Matching Contributions

- Health Savings Account (HSA)/Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) Options
- Paid Time Off (including sick, holiday, vacation, etc.)
- Tuition Reimbursement
- Growth Opportunities
- And more!

$87,900.00 - $137,500.00
  
  
Actual compensation offer to candidate may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level. The pay ratio between base pay and target incentive (if applicable) will be finalized at offer.

US-CO-Denver, Colorado (Panorama Arrow Building)

*Spectrio empowers human engagement by creating authentic experiences through content, innovation, and measurable insight that drive growth.*

**About Spectrio**

Spectrio isn’t just a digital signage provider; we are the architects of modern customer experiences. From healthcare to automotive, we empower over 150,000 global locations to transform their physical spaces into dynamic digital destinations.

Headquartered in Tampa, Florida, Spectrio consistently ranks among the fastest-growing and largest companies in the Tampa Bay area. As an 11-time Inc. 5000 honoree and a member of the Tampa Bay Business Journal’s “Fast 50” and “Tampa Bay 200,” we are a proven leader in innovation. Our software consistently receives praise for its features and ease of use on Capterra and G2, earning multiple awards for technology and creative excellence.

For more information, visit [www.spectrio.com](http://www.spectrio.com/).

*This position is open to external candidates in Florida, North Carolina, or Texas and offers the flexibility of remote work. Internal candidates are also encouraged to apply.*

**Primary Objective:** This pivotal position will orchestrate and elevate our customer education and operational training functions, aligning them closely with overarching strategic goals.  
  
**Responsibilities include:**

- Develop and implement a strategic vision for customer education programs and initiatives that align with company goals and objectives.
- Lead the conception, implementation, and oversight of robust customer education and operational training programs, harnessing diverse learning modalities and cutting-edge technologies.
- Collaborate closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure strategic alignment of customer enablement initiatives with corporate priorities.
- Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to assess the efficacy and impact of customer education and operational training programs, continuously refining them based on data-driven insights.
- Establish scalable processes for delivering training and educational resources to customers across various channels, including in-person sessions, virtual classrooms, and self-paced learning platforms.
- Cultivate a culture of perpetual learning and development, empowering both customers and employees to acquire new skills and knowledge crucial for success.
- Provide strategic direction and mentorship to a cadre of customer education specialists, Knowledge base administrators, instructional designers, trainers, and other stakeholders, ensuring seamless integration with organizational objectives.
- Forge strategic alliances and partnerships with external training providers, educational institutions, and industry luminaries to expand the reach and potency of our customer enablement initiatives.
- Champion customer education as a core pillar of our organizational strategy, serving as an influential thought leader and advocate at industry events, conferences, and forums.

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Education, Instructional Design, Business Administration, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
- Proven track record of designing and implementing successful customer education programs that drive adoption, retention, and satisfaction.
- Deep expertise in instructional design, adult learning principles, and pioneering training methodologies.
- Exceptional strategic acumen and analytical prowess, adept at translating business imperatives into actionable customer enablement strategies.
- Superlative communication and interpersonal skills, with a knack for influencing and collaborating effectively across all organizational tiers.

- Flexibility and adaptability to navigate complexity and drive transformation in a swiftly evolving business landscape.
- Passionate commitment to lifelong learning and professional growth, with an unwavering dedication to remaining at the vanguard of industry trends and best practices in customer enablement.

- **Paid Sick Leave**: All employees accrue up to 40 hours (5 days) of sick time per year.

We are committed to providing a supportive environment where your professional growth is prioritized and your personal well-being is protected. Join us as we continue to redefine the customer experience.

**This is a Fully Remote Job**

**1. About Our Client:**

The organization operates in the market intelligence space, providing an AI-driven platform that delivers insights from a broad range of public and private content such as equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, and trade journals. It addresses the challenge of removing uncertainty from decision-making for sophisticated companies, serving over 6,000 enterprise customers including a majority of the S&P 500. The company has a global presence with offices across the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland.

**2. About the Opportunity:**

The
**Senior Customer Education Manager, Enterprise**
plays a foundational role in expanding the enterprise education capabilities within the organization. This position is responsible for building and defining enterprise and custom education programs from the ground up, working closely with Customer Success, Implementation, and Revenue teams to support the deployment of the platform at strategic accounts. The role serves as a trusted consultant to enterprise clients, ensuring effective adoption and integration of products, including API-based solutions, to maximize customer value and usage.

**3. Responsibilities:**

- Collaborate with Customer Success, Implementation, Lifecycle Marketing, and Revenue teams to integrate education into enterprise account deployments.
- Develop and deliver customized education programs tailored to individual enterprise accounts.
- Advise clients on deployment strategies and facilitate adoption of API-based platform usage.
- Define engagement scopes, success criteria, and completion metrics for education initiatives.
- Create repeatable processes for education involvement in account engagements to enhance team efficiency.
- Establish and refine key metrics to measure program success and impact.
- Identify accounts with low platform usage but significant API integration and design targeted education strategies.
- Coordinate with the broader Customer Education team to adapt content and templates for enterprise needs.
- Travel occasionally to support top accounts and key project kickoffs.

**4. Requirements:**

- 8 to 12 years of experience in customer education, professional services, implementation consulting, or similar enterprise-facing roles, preferably within B2B SaaS.
- Proven ability to build programs from ambiguity, define success metrics, and iterate based on outcomes.
- Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Customer Success, Implementation, and Revenue/Sales teams during active account engagements.
- Comfort with technical concepts, including APIs, and ability to translate them into practical guidance.
- Strong change management skills to influence adoption of new workflows in account teams.
- Consultative communication skills to act as a trusted advisor on deployment and commercial impact.
- Ability to manage ambiguity and define engagement boundaries.
- Data-driven mindset with experience designing attribution models and demonstrating ROI.

**5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:**

- The pay range and compensation package for this role will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and other relevant factors.

Citian is a fast growing, venture backed SaaS technology company based in Washington, DC. Our software solutions revolutionize how our transportation and infrastructure systems – roads, rail, transit, bicycle, pedestrian – operate.

Our tech solutions:

- ****Reduce traffic fatalities****
- ****Enhance pedestrian accessibility****
- ****Empower system operators to save time & money****

You’ll work with some of the brightest minds in the software and transportation industries. Our engineers and data scientists apply the latest in emerging tech, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning to build smarter, more advanced tools for our diverse client base. We work with clients across the United States, with global ambitions in the years ahead.

**Who You Are:**

As a Customer Education Specialist at Citian, you will be building our first customer training program including overall design and setup. You'll pick and configure our LMS, build self-guided learning paths for our two products, and create a program that our team can run with. Our users are traffic engineers, planners, and GIS analysts who are busy, smart, and often new to their roles in the public sector.  Providing training to these individuals has to be practical, user-friendly, and simple to adopt.  Our preference is to have this individual based in our D.C. office, but we are open to remote candidates as well.

**Responsibilities:**

- Interview customers and our CS team to define learner personas and the skills each role needs
- Evaluate and recommend a customer-facing LMS, then configure it
- Design and build a foundational curriculum (Citian 101/102) with our CS team
- Create content that explains how our data is built and why agencies can trust it, alongside product how-to content
- Build short, task-based modules: video, interactive walkthroughs, job aids, and knowledge checks
- Pilot the program with a few customers and measure completion, adoption, and feedback
- Deliver a maintenance playbook so our team can keep content current as the products change

**Qualifications:**

- 3+ years designing training for external customers of a software product (required)
- A portfolio showing self-paced or e-learning work you designed (required)
- Hands-on experience selecting or administering a customer-facing LMS, such as Skilljar, Thinkific, Docebo, or Northpass
- Strong knowledge of adult learning principles and self-directed learning
- Fluency with authoring tools such as Articulate 360, Camtasia, or Loom-style video
- Degree in instructional design, learning technology, or a related field (preferred)
- Experience with technical, data, GIS, or public-sector audiences (a strong plus)

**Your Citian Advantage:**

- Competitive salary and benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance and generous PTO.
- 401(k) company match and monthly commuter transportation benefit
- On-site gym and free snacks in the office
- High-growth potential and opportunities for advancement within a fast growing, venture-backed SaaS startup!

Let's build smarter cities together! Learn more about Citian here: www.citian.co

\*\* Citian is an organization committed to diversity and inclusion to drive our business results and create a better future every day for our diverse employees, clients, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

**This is a Fully Remote Job**

**1. About Our Client:**

The organization operates in the market intelligence space, providing an AI-driven platform that delivers insights from a broad range of public and private content such as equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, and trade journals. It addresses the challenge of removing uncertainty from decision-making for sophisticated companies, serving over 6,000 enterprise customers including a majority of the S&P 500. The company has a global presence with offices across the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland.

**2. About the Opportunity:**

The
**Senior Customer Education Manager, Enterprise**
plays a foundational role in expanding the enterprise education capabilities within the organization. This position is responsible for building and defining enterprise and custom education programs from the ground up, working closely with Customer Success, Implementation, and Revenue teams to support the deployment of the platform at strategic accounts. The role serves as a trusted consultant to enterprise clients, ensuring effective adoption and integration of products, including API-based solutions, to maximize customer value and usage.

**3. Responsibilities:**

- Collaborate with Customer Success, Implementation, Lifecycle Marketing, and Revenue teams to integrate education into enterprise account deployments.
- Develop and deliver customized education programs tailored to individual enterprise accounts.
- Advise clients on deployment strategies and facilitate adoption of API-based platform usage.
- Define engagement scopes, success criteria, and completion metrics for education initiatives.
- Create repeatable processes for education involvement in account engagements to enhance team efficiency.
- Establish and refine key metrics to measure program success and impact.
- Identify accounts with low platform usage but significant API integration and design targeted education strategies.
- Coordinate with the broader Customer Education team to adapt content and templates for enterprise needs.
- Travel occasionally to support top accounts and key project kickoffs.

**4. Requirements:**

- 8 to 12 years of experience in customer education, professional services, implementation consulting, or similar enterprise-facing roles, preferably within B2B SaaS.
- Proven ability to build programs from ambiguity, define success metrics, and iterate based on outcomes.
- Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Customer Success, Implementation, and Revenue/Sales teams during active account engagements.
- Comfort with technical concepts, including APIs, and ability to translate them into practical guidance.
- Strong change management skills to influence adoption of new workflows in account teams.
- Consultative communication skills to act as a trusted advisor on deployment and commercial impact.
- Ability to manage ambiguity and define engagement boundaries.
- Data-driven mindset with experience designing attribution models and demonstrating ROI.

**5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:**

- The pay range and compensation package for this role will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and other relevant factors.
